evidence.reason: The current helper never reads RandomizedDelaySec; it computes the bound from calendar/repeat intervals plus AccuracySec only. Since systemd adds RandomizedDelaySec on top of the scheduled activation (and AccuracySec), a timer declaring it can activate later than this bound, so preflight can accept a deadline that the healthy repeat will miss. That is an implementation error in the intended conservative timer bound; rejecting the directive or adding its maximum delay is a routine fix, not a new requirement.
